svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 10 · Santa Cruz · 08/12 Ravine Bridges (Common)
svg.desc: Ravines cut through campus, so the paths cross them on footbridges. Look down: ferns, then more ferns. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
